okutama-and-chichibu-mountain-loop.title: Okutama and Chichibu Mountain Loop
okutama-and-chichibu-mountain-loop.slogan: Cool forest, lake water and tighter mountain rhythm.
okutama-and-chichibu-mountain-loop.story: Cool forest, lake water and tighter mountain rhythm. A 207 km loop that starts and ends near Ōme, about 3 h 59 of riding. The stops in between: Okutama Lake, Chichibu valley and Nagatoro river bends. The climb of the day is Daibosatsu high line. It tops out at about 1,150 m. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Ome exit roads → Okutama Lake
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 44 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Blackstone Valley Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 24 km this is Blackstone Valley Byway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
